company.name: Medigram
company.shortDescription: Clinical AI orchestration platform scaling governed outliers with IEEE UL 2933
company.description: Medigram is a clinical AI orchestration platform that develops Starter Packs embedding IEEE UL 2933 (TIPPSS) and OWASP GenAI controls into real-time healthcare workflows. Using digital-twin simulation and stage-gated governance, Medigram contains most pilots and scales only reproducible outliers across sites, reflecting the portfolio logic of the medical device industry. The company’s leadership drives healthcare AI governance through TTIC, IEEE UL 2933, and global events such as AIMed25.

aiResearchSummary.text: Medigram is focused on enhancing mobile communication for physicians through a system that efficiently receives communications and provides alerts. Their development includes a messaging platform that interfaces with a compact dedicated device (CDD), which receives messages via a paging system before they reach the mobile device. This approach aims to streamline the delivery of critical information to healthcare professionals, ensuring timely and reliable communication in clinical settings.
